Introduction

Kimi, formerly known as Habin, is a South Korean rapper. She is best known for appearing as a contestant on Produce 101, under her real name Kim Minji. However, she was eliminated in episode 10 after ranking 44th place.

Kimi made her official debut on March 22, 2011 as a member of the girl group Leader'S. During her time in the group, she participated in the group's sub-units Leader'S G, Leader'S N, and Leader'S T before leaving the group altogether in late 2012.

After a 2 year hiatus, she would go on to debut in multiple other groups such as Scarlet (2014-2015), BULLDOK (2016-2018), and We Girls (2018-2022). From 2022 to 2024, she promoted with the group ONAIR (now known as 3piece) but left a few months before the group made their official debuted.

In addition to her group activities, she made her solo debut on August 25, 2017, with the digital single "I AM".
